instrumentationLimits: CDP screencast frames are actual composed pages with real timestamps; their spacing is variable and is not an original fixed animation timer.

The actor-canvas diagnostic copies pixels inside actual requestAnimationFrame callbacks, including hidden frames. Opacity is recorded separately; a hidden actor image does not prove it was visible in the compositor.

The no-capture diagnostic wraps PIXI.Renderer.render for start/end timing, calls the original exactly once, and restores it. It changes no transport, motion, or animation clock. Callback logging still has overhead.
There is no claim that any instrumented run has zero overhead, or that a browser scheduling gap is authored game waiting.
